description: This file implements a command-line shell interface for controlling voltage and current regulators in Zephyr OS, including enabling/disabling regulators, setting/getting voltages and currents, and managing regulator modes and errors.

methods.name: strtomicro
methods.description: Converts a string with units (u, m, or none) to an integer value in micro units.

methods.name: microtoshell
methods.description: Prints a voltage or current value in a human-readable format with units.

methods.name: cmd_vlist
methods.description: Lists supported voltages for a regulator.

methods.name: cmd_vset
methods.description: Sets the voltage for a regulator.

methods.name: cmd_vget
methods.description: Gets the current voltage of a regulator.

methods.name: cmd_clist
methods.description: Lists current limits supported by a regulator.

methods.name: cmd_iset
methods.description: Sets the current limit for a regulator.

methods.name: cmd_iget
methods.description: Gets the current limit of a regulator.

methods.name: cmd_modeset
methods.description: Sets the mode of a regulator.

methods.name: cmd_modeget
methods.description: Gets the mode of a regulator.

methods.name: cmd_adset
methods.description: Sets active discharge for a regulator.

methods.name: cmd_adget
methods.description: Gets active discharge status of a regulator.

methods.name: cmd_errors
methods.description: Retrieves error flags from a regulator.

methods.name: cmd_dvsset
methods.description: Sets DVS (Dynamic Voltage Scaling) state for a regulator.

methods.name: cmd_shipmode
methods.description: Enables ship mode for a regulator.

methods.name: device_name_get
methods.description: Retrieves device names for shell commands.
